name: Cell Wall Integrity (CWI) Pathway and Pkc1 Signaling
description: The Cell Wall Integrity (CWI) pathway responds to cell wall stress via surface sensors (Wsc1/2/3, Mid2, Mtl1) detecting cell wall damage or osmotic stress. Sensors activate Rho1 GTPase via GEFs (Rom1/2). Rho1-GTP activates Pkc1 kinase, initiating a MAPK cascade: Bck1 (MAPKKK) → Mkk1/2 (MAPKK) → Slt2/Mpk1 (MAPK). Activated Slt2 phosphorylates transcription factors Rlm1 and SBF (Swi4/Swi6), inducing cell wall biosynthesis genes. Rho1 also directly activates β-1,3-glucan synthase for immediate wall repair.
scientificAccuracy: Based on extensive research on yeast cell wall signaling. Paradigm for fungal cell wall stress response.
